sanjay (eng-platform): thinking aloud — we need a decision: keep internal services gRPC/protos and either (A) run a central adaptive gateway that transcodes JSON<->proto for REST clients, or (B) ship a lightweight gRPC-bridge sidecar with each service that does translation + enrichment. main concerns: telemetry fidelity, per-client quotas, and rollout UX. thoughts? :thinking:

maya (eng-runtime): my +1 is leaning to sidecar for the latency-sensitive paths. sidecars can attach rich metadata (model-version, routing-policy) before it hits the backend, avoid expensive transcoding in the central gateway. downside: more infra surface and upgrades everywhere. :shrug:

olivia (eng-api): gateway wins for developer DX. most product teams want simple OpenAPI + JSON. a gateway lets us expose stable REST contracts and do A/B rollouts per-route without touching services. Also easier to add per-route quotas at the edge. :thumbsup:

ken (eng-sre): both have tradeoffs for telemetry. gateway centralizes quota enforcement + logging but can mask backend resource signals. if we go gateway, we need strict propagation of trace/span IDs and a telemetry contract so we don't lose proto-level metrics. suggestion: require these headers: x-request-id, x-rw-model, x-routing-policy and force sampling=1 for troubleshooting flows.

maya (eng-runtime): example envoy grpc-json transcoder snippet for the gateway approach — it works but has limits (won't preserve unknown proto options or binary fields well):

```
# envoy grpc_json_transcoder example
http_filters:
  - name: envoy.grpc_json_transcoder
    typed_config:
      proto_descriptor: "/etc/protos/model.pb"
      services: ["inference.ModelService"]
```

maya (eng-runtime): Also with gateway, KV cache keys get tricky — the gateway would need to surface cacheable prefixes or we risk cache fragmentation. sidecars can share local cache semantics with the runtime.

olivia (eng-api): rollout UX: with gateway we can do gradual route weight shifts and per-client rules (feature flags) without any deploys. sidecar requires coordinated deploys if the translation contract changes. big + for gateway here.

sanjay (eng-platform): hybrid thought: gateway default for external/console and low-traffic internal teams; sidecars for latency-critical, high-throughput model-serving lanes. instrument both with the same telemetry contract. perf experiment plan: prototype both on a single model endpoint and measure p50/p95, CPU classification (transcode cost), and token throughput per GPU. any volunteers to run prototype?

ken (eng-sre): agree on telemetry contract first — i'll draft a short RFC. also we should add per-route quota semantics to the console (so product teams can see quota usage when gateway enforces limits). console-bot: could you create a dashboard template? :eyes:

console-bot: created dashboard "api-adaptor-proposal" with panels: p95 latency, request rate, gateway CPU, sidecar CPU, decoded payload-size. link: https://console.internal/d/dc123/api-adaptor-proposal

olivia (eng-api): we should also capture a compatibility guideline: if adding new proto fields, the gateway should ignore unknown fields gracefully and map them to extension metadata, not 400.

maya (eng-runtime): one more: telemetry fidelity — if gateway aggregates or normalizes fields, add original_proto_size and original_field_presence flags so we can detect silent lossy transcoding.

deploy-bot: test-deploy started for "adaptor-prototype" on staging (build 0.3.7). logs: https://ci.internal/build/0.3.7 :rocket:

sanjay (eng-platform): ok next steps: ken drafts telemetry contract RFC by EOW, olivia sketches gateway route rules + canary UX, maya wires sidecar prototype. i'll coordinate results and pick metrics for the perf run. volunteers: @maya, @olivia, @ken?

maya (eng-runtime): i'll take the sidecar prototype.

olivia (eng-api): i'll own the gateway rules + canary UX mockups.

ken (eng-sre): i'll draft the telemetry/quotas RFC and a dashboard template.

sanjay (eng-platform): awesome. leaving notes here; will follow up with a short meeting invite for Friday to review prototypes. :calendar:

olivia (eng-api): thanks — keeping the gateway option open but we need those fidelity checks. :+1:
